
We use a handcrafted reactive policy. The first hidden layer computes sensor readings: player x/y, danger x/y, reward x/y, oxygen level, diver count, and row-specific features. The second hidden layer computes relative positions (reward vs. player, danger vs. player), normalized oxygen, and diver presence. The output layer moves toward rewards, avoids danger, and surfaces when oxygen is low and divers are aboard. Firing is triggered when movement logits become small (i.e., when aligned and close to a reward).
